channels.discord.voice.agentSession.help: Controls which OpenClaw conversation receives voice turns. Leave unset for the voice channel session, or set mode="target" with a Discord target such as channel:123 to make voice an extension of an existing text channel session.

channels.discord.voice.agentSession.targ.label: Discord Voice Agent Session Target
channels.discord.voice.agentSession.targ.help: Discord target used when voice.agentSession.mode="target", for example channel:123.

channels.discord.voice.followUsersEnable.label: Discord Voice Follow Users Enabled
channels.discord.voice.followUsersEnable.help: Toggle Discord voice follow-users behavior without removing the saved voice.followUsers list. Defaults to true when followUsers is configured.

channels.discord.voice.followUsers.label: Discord Voice Follow Users
channels.discord.voice.followUsers.help: Discord user IDs to follow into voice channels. The bot joins when a followed user joins or moves, and leaves when that user disconnects.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.provider.label: Discord Realtime Provider
channels.discord.voice.realtime.provider.help: Realtime voice provider for agent-proxy or bidi Discord voice modes, such as openai.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.model.label: Discord Realtime Model
channels.discord.voice.realtime.model.help: Provider realtime session model, such as gpt-realtime-2.1. This is separate from voice.model, which remains the OpenClaw agent brain model.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.speakerV.label: Discord Realtime Speaker Voice
channels.discord.voice.realtime.speakerV.help: Provider realtime output voice name, such as cedar.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.toolPoli.label: Discord Realtime Tool Policy
channels.discord.voice.realtime.toolPoli.help: Tool policy for the OpenClaw agent consult tool in realtime voice modes: safe-read-only, owner, or none. Default is owner for agent-proxy and safe-read-only for bidi.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.consultP.label: Discord Realtime Consult Policy
channels.discord.voice.realtime.consultP.help: Use always to strongly prefer the OpenClaw agent brain for substantive realtime turns. agent-proxy defaults to always.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.requireW.label: Discord Realtime Require Wake Name
channels.discord.voice.realtime.requireW.help: Control OpenAI agent-proxy wake-name gating. Unset listens naturally with one human and requires a wake name with two or more; true always requires one and false never does.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.wakeName.label: Discord Realtime Wake Names
channels.discord.voice.realtime.wakeName.help: One- or two-word activation names used whenever OpenAI agent-proxy Discord realtime voice has an active wake-name gate.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.bootstra.label: Discord Realtime Bootstrap Context Files
channels.discord.voice.realtime.bootstra.help: Agent profile bootstrap files included in realtime provider instructions for direct voice identity/persona grounding. Defaults to IDENTITY.md, USER.md, and SOUL.md; set [] to disable.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.bargeIn.label: Discord Realtime Barge-In
channels.discord.voice.realtime.bargeIn.help: Allow Discord speaker-start events to interrupt active realtime playback. Set true to keep manual interruption when provider input-audio interruption is disabled for echo control.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.minBarge.label: Discord Realtime Minimum Barge-In Audio (ms)
channels.discord.voice.realtime.minBarge.help: Minimum assistant playback duration before a Discord barge-in truncates realtime audio. Default: 250; set 0 for immediate interruption in low-echo rooms.

channels.discord.voice.realtime.provider.label: Discord Realtime Provider Settings
channels.discord.voice.realtime.provider.help: Provider-specific realtime voice settings keyed by provider id.

channels.discord.voice.autoJoin.label: Discord Voice Auto-Join
channels.discord.voice.autoJoin.help: Voice channels to auto-join (list of guildId/channelId entries). Set whenOccupied on an entry to connect only while humans are present.

channels.discord.voice.autoJoin.*.whenOc.label: Discord Voice Auto-Join When Occupied
channels.discord.voice.autoJoin.*.whenOc.help: Join and remain in this auto-managed voice channel only while at least one human is present. The OpenClaw bot and other bots do not count. Default: false.

channels.discord.voice.allowedChannels.label: Discord Voice Allowed Channels
channels.discord.voice.allowedChannels.help: Optional voice channel residency allowlist. When set, /vc join, auto-join, and bot voice-state moves are restricted to these guildId/channelId entries. Leave unset to allow any voice channel.

channels.discord.voice.daveEncryption.label: Discord Voice DAVE Encryption
channels.discord.voice.daveEncryption.help: Toggle DAVE end-to-end encryption for Discord voice joins (default: true in @discordjs/voice; Discord may require this).

channels.discord.voice.decryptionFailure.label: Discord Voice Decrypt Failure Tolerance
channels.discord.voice.decryptionFailure.help: Consecutive decrypt failures before DAVE attempts session recovery (passed to @discordjs/voice; default: 24).

channels.discord.voice.connectTimeoutMs.label: Discord Voice Connect Timeout (ms)
channels.discord.voice.connectTimeoutMs.help: Initial @discordjs/voice Ready wait before a join is treated as failed. Default: 30000.

channels.discord.voice.reconnectGraceMs.label: Discord Voice Reconnect Grace (ms)
channels.discord.voice.reconnectGraceMs.help: Grace period for a disconnected Discord voice session to enter Signalling or Connecting before OpenClaw destroys it. Default: 15000.

channels.discord.voice.captureSilenceGra.label: Discord Voice Capture Silence Grace (ms)
channels.discord.voice.captureSilenceGra.help: Silence window after Discord reports a speaker ended before OpenClaw finalizes the audio segment for transcription. Default: 2000.

channels.discord.voice.tts.label: Discord Voice Text-to-Speech
channels.discord.voice.tts.help: Optional TTS overrides for Discord voice playback (merged with tts).

channels.discord.pluralkit.enabled.label: Discord PluralKit Enabled
channels.discord.pluralkit.enabled.help: Resolve PluralKit proxied messages and treat system members as distinct senders.

channels.discord.pluralkit.token.label: Discord PluralKit Token
channels.discord.pluralkit.token.help: Optional PluralKit token for resolving private systems or members.

channels.discord.activity.label: Discord Presence Activity
channels.discord.activity.help: Discord presence activity text (defaults to custom status).

channels.discord.status.label: Discord Presence Status
channels.discord.status.help: Discord presence status (online, dnd, idle, invisible).

channels.discord.autoPresence.enabled.label: Discord Auto Presence Enabled
channels.discord.autoPresence.enabled.help: Enable automatic Discord bot presence updates based on runtime/model availability signals. When enabled: healthy=>online, degraded/unknown=>idle, exhausted/unavailable=>dnd.

channels.discord.autoPresence.intervalMs.label: Discord Auto Presence Check Interval (ms)
channels.discord.autoPresence.intervalMs.help: How often to evaluate Discord auto-presence state in milliseconds (default: 30000).

channels.discord.autoPresence.minUpdateI.label: Discord Auto Presence Min Update Interval (ms)
channels.discord.autoPresence.minUpdateI.help: Minimum time between actual Discord presence update calls in milliseconds (default: 15000). Prevents status spam on noisy state changes.

channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.label: Discord Online Presence Events
channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.help: Route selected human offline-to-online transitions into the configured guild channel as agent system events. Requires the Guild Presences privileged intent and an enabled agent heartbeat.

channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.label: Discord Online Presence Events Enabled
channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.help: Enable online-presence agent wakes for this guild. Defaults to true when presenceEvents is configured.

channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.label: Discord Online Presence Target Channel
channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.help: Numeric Discord channel ID whose routed agent session receives online-presence events and greeting delivery.

channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.label: Discord Online Presence User IDs
channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.help: Optional immutable Discord user ID allowlist. Omit to include all human members in the guild.

channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.label: Discord Online Presence Reconnect Suppression
channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.help: Suppress online-presence events for this many seconds after a new Gateway session while guild presence state is rebuilt. Resumed sessions are unaffected. 0 disables. Default: 300.

channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.label: Discord Online Presence Burst Limit
channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.help: Maximum successfully queued online-presence events for this guild per burst window; the rest are suppressed and logged once. Default: 8.

channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.label: Discord Online Presence Burst Window
channels.discord.guilds.*.presenceEvents.help: Sliding window in seconds used for burst detection. Default: 60.

channels.discord.activityUrl.label: Discord Presence Activity URL
channels.discord.activityUrl.help: Discord presence streaming URL (required for activityType=1).

channels.discord.allowBots.label: Discord Allow Bot Messages
channels.discord.allowBots.help: Allow bot-authored messages through normal Discord mention and access rules (default: true). Set false to disable bot-triggered turns, or "mentions" to require a bot mention. Accessible bot messages remain available as conversation context.

channels.discord.botLoopProtection.label: Discord Bot Loop Protection
channels.discord.botLoopProtection.help: Sliding-window guard for bot-to-bot Discord loops. Default is enabled whenever allowBots lets bot-authored messages reach dispatch.

channels.discord.botLoopProtection.enabl.label: Discord Bot Loop Protection Enabled
channels.discord.botLoopProtection.enabl.help: Enable the bot-pair loop guard. Defaults to true when allowBots is true or "mentions", and false when bot messages are ignored.

channels.discord.botLoopProtection.maxEv.label: Discord Bot Pair Events Per Window
channels.discord.botLoopProtection.maxEv.help: Maximum messages a single Discord bot pair may exchange in the configured window before suppression starts. Default: 20.

channels.discord.botLoopProtection.windo.label: Discord Bot Loop Window Seconds
channels.discord.botLoopProtection.windo.help: Sliding window length in seconds for Discord bot-pair loop budgets. Default: 60.

channels.discord.botLoopProtection.coold.label: Discord Bot Loop Cooldown Seconds
channels.discord.botLoopProtection.coold.help: Seconds to suppress a Discord bot pair after it exceeds the loop budget. Default: 60.

channels.discord.mentionAliases.label: Discord Mention Aliases
channels.discord.mentionAliases.help: Map outbound @handle text to stable Discord user IDs before sending. Set per account via channels.discord.accounts.<id>.mentionAliases.

channels.discord.token.label: Discord Bot Token
channels.discord.token.help: Discord bot token used for gateway and REST API authentication for this provider account. Keep this secret out of committed config and rotate immediately after any leak.

channels.discord.applicationId.label: Discord Application ID
channels.discord.applicationId.help: Optional Discord application/client ID. Set this when hosted environments cannot reach Discord's application lookup endpoint during startup.

channels.discord.activities.label: Discord Activities
channels.discord.activities.help: Enable the Discord Activity presenter for the core show_widget tool on this account. Activity routes and the launch handler remain disabled when this block is absent.

channels.discord.activities.clientSecret.label: Discord Activities Client Secret
channels.discord.activities.clientSecret.help: OAuth2 client secret for the Discord application. DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET is used when this field is unset.

channels.discord.activities.applicationI.label: Discord Activities Application ID
channels.discord.activities.applicationI.help: Optional Activity application ID. Defaults to the bot application ID learned at gateway startup.

channels.feishu.label: Feishu
channels.feishu.help: 飞书/Lark enterprise messaging with doc/wiki/drive tools.

channels.googlechat.label: Google Chat
channels.googlechat.help: Google Workspace Chat app with HTTP webhook.

channels.imessage.label: iMessage
channels.imessage.help: Local iMessage/SMS through the imsg bridge, including private API message actions when enabled.

channels.imessage.dmPolicy.label: iMessage DM Policy
channels.imessage.dmPolicy.help: Direct message access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.imessage.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.imessage.configWrites.label: iMessage Config Writes
channels.imessage.configWrites.help: Allow iMessage to write config in response to channel events/commands (default: true).

channels.imessage.allowFrom.help: Sender ids allowed to reach the agent. Required by "allowlist"; use ["*"] to allow everyone.

channels.imessage.defaultTo.help: Target used for outbound messages when the caller supplies none.

channels.imessage.groupAllowFrom.help: Sender ids allowed in group chats. Falls back to allowFrom when unset.

channels.imessage.groups.*.requireMentio.label: iMessage Bot Thread Mention Requirement
channels.imessage.groups.*.requireMentio.help: Override mention gating in native reply threads started by this account. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention and keeps threads quiet when mention patterns are disabled. Omit to preserve normal gating. Ownership uses the bounded cache of messages OpenClaw sent; sender restrictions still apply.

channels.imessage.accounts.*.groups.*.re.label: iMessage Account Bot Thread Mention Requirement
channels.imessage.accounts.*.groups.*.re.help: Override mention gating in native reply threads whose root this account sent. Unknown or evicted roots keep the group's normal mention requirement.

channels.imessage.accounts.*.defaultTo.help: Target used for outbound messages when the caller supplies none.

channels.imessage.cliPath.label: iMessage CLI Path
channels.imessage.cliPath.help: Filesystem path to the iMessage bridge CLI binary used for send/receive operations. Set explicitly when the binary is not on PATH in service runtime environments.

channels.imessage.sendTransport.label: iMessage Send Transport
channels.imessage.sendTransport.help: Preferred imsg RPC send transport for normal outbound replies. "auto" uses the IMCore bridge when available, "bridge" requires it, and "applescript" forces Messages automation.

channels.irc.label: IRC
channels.irc.help: classic IRC networks with DM/channel routing and pairing controls.

channels.irc.dmPolicy.label: IRC DM Policy
channels.irc.dmPolicy.help: Direct message access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.irc.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.irc.nickserv.enabled.label: IRC NickServ Enabled
channels.irc.nickserv.enabled.help: Enable NickServ identify/register after connect (defaults to enabled when password is configured).

channels.irc.nickserv.passwordFile.label: IRC NickServ Password File
channels.irc.nickserv.passwordFile.help: Optional file path containing NickServ password.

channels.irc.nickserv.register.label: IRC NickServ Register
channels.irc.nickserv.register.help: If true, send NickServ REGISTER on every connect. Use once for initial registration, then disable.

channels.irc.nickserv.registerEmail.label: IRC NickServ Register Email
channels.irc.nickserv.registerEmail.help: Email used with NickServ REGISTER (required when register=true).

channels.irc.configWrites.label: IRC Config Writes
channels.irc.configWrites.help: Allow IRC to write config in response to channel events/commands (default: true).

channels.line.joinIntro.label: LINE Group Join Introduction
channels.line.joinIntro.help: Post one brief introduction when the bot joins an allowed LINE group or multi-person room (default: true). Account settings override the channel-wide setting.

channels.matrix.label: Matrix
channels.matrix.help: open protocol; install the plugin to enable.

channels.matrix.requireMentionInBotThrea.label: Mention in Bot Threads
channels.matrix.requireMentionInBotThrea.help: Require a mention in threads rooted in this bot's own Matrix events. Set false to accept unmentioned follow-ups; omit to preserve the room's existing mention behavior.

channels.matrix.rooms.*.requireMentionIn.label: Mention in Bot Threads
channels.matrix.rooms.*.requireMentionIn.help: Override the account's bot-created thread mention policy for this Matrix room. Exact room entries replace wildcard room settings.

channels.matrix.groups.*.requireMentionI.label: Mention in Bot Threads
channels.matrix.groups.*.requireMentionI.help: Override the account's bot-created thread mention policy for this Matrix room. Exact room entries replace wildcard room settings.

channels.matrix.joinIntro.label: Matrix Group Join Introduction
channels.matrix.joinIntro.help: Post one brief introduction when the bot joins an allowed group room (default: true). Account settings override the channel-wide setting.

channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.label: Matrix Mention Pattern Policy
channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.help: Scopes configured groupChat mentionPatterns to selected Matrix room IDs. Native Matrix mention evidence still triggers even when regex patterns are denied.

channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.mode.label: Matrix Mention Pattern Mode
channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.mode.help: "allow" enables configured regex mention patterns unless denyIn matches; "deny" disables them unless allowIn matches.

channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.allowIn.label: Matrix Mention Pattern Allowlist
channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.allowIn.help: Matrix room IDs where configured regex mention patterns are enabled when mode is deny.

channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.denyIn.label: Matrix Mention Pattern Denylist
channels.matrix.mentionPatterns.denyIn.help: Matrix room IDs where configured regex mention patterns are disabled. Native mention evidence still triggers.

channels.matrix.allowBots.label: Matrix Allow Bot Messages
channels.matrix.allowBots.help: Allow messages from other configured Matrix bot accounts to trigger replies (default: false). Set "mentions" to require a visible room mention.

channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.label: Matrix Bot Loop Protection
channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.help: Sliding-window guard for accepted Matrix configured-bot loops. Default is enabled whenever allowBots lets configured bot messages reach dispatch.

channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.enable.label: Matrix Bot Loop Protection Enabled
channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.enable.help: Enable the bot-pair loop guard. Defaults to true when allowBots is true or "mentions", and false when configured bot messages are ignored.

channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.maxEve.label: Matrix Bot Loop Events per Window
channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.maxEve.help: Maximum accepted bot-pair messages within the sliding window before suppression starts. Default: 20.

channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.window.label: Matrix Bot Loop Window Seconds
channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.window.help: Sliding window length for counting bot-pair messages. Default: 60.

channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.cooldo.label: Matrix Bot Loop Cooldown Seconds
channels.matrix.botLoopProtection.cooldo.help: How long to suppress the bot pair after it exceeds the budget. Default: 60.

channels.matrix.dangerouslyAllowNameMatc.label: Matrix Display Name Matching
channels.matrix.dangerouslyAllowNameMatc.help: Compatibility opt-in for resolving Matrix display names and joined room names in allowlists. Prefer full @user:server IDs and room IDs or aliases because names are mutable.

channels.matrix.streaming.progress.label.label: Matrix Progress Label
channels.matrix.streaming.progress.label.help: Initial progress draft title. Use "auto" for built-in single-word labels, a custom string, or false to hide the title.

channels.matrix.streaming.progress.label.label: Matrix Progress Label Pool
channels.matrix.streaming.progress.label.help: Candidate labels for streaming.progress.label="auto". Leave unset to use the built-in "Working" label.

channels.matrix.streaming.progress.maxLi.label: Matrix Progress Max Lines
channels.matrix.streaming.progress.maxLi.help: Maximum number of compact progress lines to keep below the draft label (default: 8).

channels.matrix.streaming.progress.maxLi.label: Matrix Progress Max Line Chars
channels.matrix.streaming.progress.maxLi.help: Maximum characters per compact progress line before truncation (default: 120). Prose cuts at word boundaries; commands and paths keep useful suffixes.

channels.matrix.streaming.progress.toolP.label: Matrix Progress Tool Lines
channels.matrix.streaming.progress.toolP.help: Show individual tool activity, including intermediate failures, in progress drafts (default: false). Quiet drafts retain plans, approval requests, and authored progress text. Terminal task errors remain visible.

channels.matrix.streaming.progress.comma.label: Matrix Progress Command Text
channels.matrix.streaming.progress.comma.help: Command/exec detail in progress draft lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.mattermost.label: Mattermost
channels.mattermost.help: self-hosted Slack-style chat; install the plugin to enable.

channels.mattermost.requireMentionInBotT.label: Mention in Bot Threads
channels.mattermost.requireMentionInBotT.help: Require an explicit mention or configured trigger in threads rooted in this bot's own posts. Set false to accept unmentioned follow-ups; omit to preserve existing mention and participation behavior.

channels.mattermost.groups.*.requireMent.label: Mention in Bot Threads
channels.mattermost.groups.*.requireMent.help: Override bot-created thread mention policy for this Mattermost channel. Exact channel settings override the wildcard, then the account setting.

channels.mattermost.allowBots.label: Mattermost Allow Bot Posts
channels.mattermost.allowBots.help: Allow posts from Mattermost bot accounts to trigger replies (default: true). Set false to ignore them, or "mentions" to require an explicit @mention or onchar trigger in channels; thread participation does not count. Access, mention, and loop-protection rules still apply.

channels.mattermost.groups.*.allowBots.label: Mattermost Allow Bot Posts
channels.mattermost.groups.*.allowBots.help: Override allowBots for this Mattermost channel. Exact channel settings override the wildcard, then the account setting.

channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.label: Mattermost Bot Loop Protection
channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.help: Sliding-window guard for Mattermost bot-to-bot loops. Default is enabled whenever allowBots lets bot posts reach dispatch.

channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.en.label: Mattermost Bot Loop Protection Enabled
channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.en.help: Enable the bot-pair loop guard. Defaults to true when allowBots is true or "mentions"; bot posts are ignored when allowBots is false.

channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.ma.label: Mattermost Bot Loop Events per Window
channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.ma.help: Maximum accepted bot-pair posts within the sliding window before suppression starts. Default: 20.

channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.wi.label: Mattermost Bot Loop Window Seconds
channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.wi.help: Sliding window length for counting bot-pair posts. Default: 60.

channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.co.label: Mattermost Bot Loop Cooldown Seconds
channels.mattermost.botLoopProtection.co.help: How long to suppress the bot pair after it exceeds the budget. Default: 60.

channels.mattermost.groups.*.botLoopProt.label: Mattermost Channel Bot Loop Protection
channels.mattermost.groups.*.botLoopProt.help: Per-channel loop guard overrides, merged key by key over the wildcard and account settings.

channels.mattermost.dmPolicy.label: Mattermost DM Policy
channels.mattermost.dmPolicy.help: Direct message access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.mattermost.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.label: Mattermost Implicit Mentions
channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.help: Control which Mattermost reply, quote, and thread-participation signals count as mentions. Unset flags preserve the channel defaults.

channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.rep.label: Mattermost Replies to Bot
channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.rep.help: Treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.quo.label: Mattermost Quoted Bot Messages
channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.quo.help: Treat messages quoting the bot as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.thr.label: Mattermost Thread Participation
channels.mattermost.implicitMentions.thr.help: Treat follow-ups in threads where the bot participated as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.mattermost.streaming.label: Mattermost Streaming Mode
channels.mattermost.streaming.help: Unified Mattermost stream preview mode: "off" | "partial" | "block" | "progress". "progress" keeps a single editable progress draft until final delivery.

channels.mattermost.streaming.block.enab.label: Mattermost Block Streaming Enabled
channels.mattermost.streaming.block.enab.help: Enable chunked block-style Mattermost preview delivery when channels.mattermost.streaming.mode="block".

channels.mattermost.streaming.block.coal.label: Mattermost Block Streaming Coalesce
channels.mattermost.streaming.block.coal.help: Merge streamed Mattermost block replies before final delivery.

channels.mattermost.streaming.preview.to.label: Mattermost Draft Tool Progress
channels.mattermost.streaming.preview.to.help: Show tool/progress activity in the live draft preview post (default: true). Set false to hide interim tool updates while the draft preview stays active.

channels.mattermost.streaming.preview.co.label: Mattermost Draft Command Text
channels.mattermost.streaming.preview.co.help: Command/exec detail in preview tool-progress lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.l.label: Mattermost Progress Label
channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.l.help: Initial progress draft title. Use "auto" for built-in single-word labels, a custom string, or false to hide the title.

channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.l.label: Mattermost Progress Label Pool
channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.l.help: Candidate labels for streaming.progress.label="auto". Leave unset to use the built-in "Working" label.

channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.m.label: Mattermost Progress Max Lines
channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.m.help: Maximum number of compact progress lines to keep below the draft label (default: 8).

channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.m.label: Mattermost Progress Max Line Chars
channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.m.help: Maximum characters per compact progress line before truncation (default: 120). Prose cuts at word boundaries; commands and paths keep useful suffixes.

channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.t.label: Mattermost Progress Tool Lines
channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.t.help: Show individual tool activity, including intermediate failures, in progress drafts (default: false). Quiet drafts retain plans, approval requests, and authored progress text. Terminal task errors remain visible.

channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.c.label: Mattermost Progress Command Text
channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.c.help: Command/exec detail in progress draft lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.msteams.configWrites.label: MS Teams Config Writes
channels.msteams.configWrites.help: Allow Microsoft Teams to write config in response to channel events/commands (default: true).

channels.msteams.cloud.label: MS Teams Cloud
channels.msteams.cloud.help: Teams SDK cloud environment for auth, token validation, and token services: "Public", "USGov", "USGovDoD", or "China" (default: Public).

channels.msteams.serviceUrl.label: MS Teams Service URL
channels.msteams.serviceUrl.help: Bot Connector service URL for SDK proactive sends/edits/deletes. Set with cloud for USGov/DoD; set alone for GCC.

channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback.label: MS Teams Graph Media Fallback
channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback.help: Query Microsoft Graph for unresolved channel or group-chat HTML media. Adds one lookup per matching message when enabled (default: false).

channels.msteams.requireMentionInBotThre.label: Require Mentions in Bot Threads
channels.msteams.requireMentionInBotThre.help: Override mention requirements for channel threads rooted at this bot's tracked messages. Unset preserves existing behavior. Channel overrides win over team and global values. Ownership tracking lasts up to 24 hours.

channels.msteams.teams.*.requireMentionI.label: Team Bot Thread Mentions
channels.msteams.teams.*.requireMentionI.help: Override mention requirements for this bot's channel threads in this team. Unset inherits the global value.

channels.msteams.teams.*.channels.*.requ.label: Channel Bot Thread Mentions
channels.msteams.teams.*.channels.*.requ.help: Override mention requirements for this bot's threads in this channel. Unset inherits the team or global value.

channels.msteams.streaming.label: MS Teams Streaming
channels.msteams.streaming.help: Microsoft Teams preview/progress streaming mode: "off" | "partial" | "block" | "progress". Personal chats use Teams native streaminfo progress when available.

channels.msteams.streaming.progress.labe.label: MS Teams Progress Label
channels.msteams.streaming.progress.labe.help: Initial progress title. Use "auto" for built-in single-word labels, a custom string, or false to hide the title.

channels.msteams.streaming.progress.labe.label: MS Teams Progress Label Pool
channels.msteams.streaming.progress.labe.help: Candidate labels for streaming.progress.label="auto". Leave unset to use OpenClaw built-in progress labels.

channels.msteams.streaming.progress.maxL.label: MS Teams Progress Max Lines
channels.msteams.streaming.progress.maxL.help: Maximum number of compact progress lines to keep below the progress title (default: 8).

channels.msteams.streaming.progress.maxL.label: MS Teams Progress Max Line Chars
channels.msteams.streaming.progress.maxL.help: Maximum characters per compact progress line before truncation (default: 120). Prose cuts at word boundaries; commands and paths keep useful suffixes.

channels.msteams.streaming.progress.tool.label: MS Teams Progress Tool Lines
channels.msteams.streaming.progress.tool.help: Show individual tool activity, including intermediate failures, in progress drafts (default: false). Quiet drafts retain plans, approval requests, and authored progress text. Terminal task errors remain visible.

channels.msteams.streaming.progress.comm.label: MS Teams Progress Command Text
channels.msteams.streaming.progress.comm.help: Command/exec detail in progress lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.nextcloud-talk.label: Nextcloud Talk
channels.nextcloud-talk.help: Self-hosted chat via Nextcloud Talk webhook bots.

channels.nextcloud-talk.mediaAllowFrom.label: Nextcloud Talk Inbound Media Allowlist
channels.nextcloud-talk.mediaAllowFrom.help: User IDs whose attachments may be processed after ordinary access and mention checks. Omitted or empty denies all media; use ["*"] for every otherwise-authorized sender.

channels.nextcloud-talk.accounts.*.media.label: Nextcloud Talk Account Inbound Media Allowlist
channels.nextcloud-talk.accounts.*.media.help: Per-account attachment allowlist. Omitted inherits the root allowlist; an empty list denies all media; use ["*"] for every otherwise-authorized sender.

channels.nostr.label: Nostr
channels.nostr.help: Decentralized protocol; encrypted DMs via NIP-04.

channels.qa-channel.label: QA Channel
channels.qa-channel.help: Synthetic Slack-class transport for automated OpenClaw QA scenarios.

channels.raft.label: Raft
channels.raft.help: Raft CLI wake bridge for human and agent collaboration.

channels.signal.label: Signal
channels.signal.help: signal-cli linked device with additional setup for the local REST bridge.

channels.signal.dmPolicy.label: Signal DM Policy
channels.signal.dmPolicy.help: Direct message access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.signal.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.signal.configWrites.label: Signal Config Writes
channels.signal.configWrites.help: Allow Signal to write config in response to channel events/commands (default: true).

channels.signal.account.label: Signal Account
channels.signal.account.help: Signal account identifier (phone/number handle) used to bind this channel config to a specific Signal identity. Keep this aligned with your linked device/session state.

channels.signal.allowFrom.help: Sender ids allowed to reach the agent. Required by "allowlist"; use ["*"] to allow everyone.

channels.signal.defaultTo.help: Target used for outbound messages when the caller supplies none.

channels.signal.groupAllowFrom.help: Sender ids allowed in group chats. Falls back to allowFrom when unset.

channels.signal.reactionAllowlist.help: Sender ids whose reactions reach the agent when reactionNotifications is "allowlist".

channels.signal.accounts.*.defaultTo.help: Target used for outbound messages when the caller supplies none.

channels.signal.transport.label: Signal Transport
channels.signal.transport.help: Account-owned native process or external endpoint configuration. Named accounts do not inherit this value.

channels.signal.transport.kind.label: Signal Transport Kind
channels.signal.transport.kind.help: Use managed-native to let OpenClaw start signal-cli, external-native for an existing native daemon, or container for signal-cli-rest-api.

channels.signal.transport.configPath.label: Signal CLI Config Path
channels.signal.transport.configPath.help: Optional directory passed to signal-cli via --config when the service needs a non-default signal-cli data path.

channels.signal.transport.socketPath.label: Signal UNIX Socket Path
channels.signal.transport.socketPath.help: Opt-in managed-native transport on POSIX. Use an absolute socket path in a private directory owned by the Gateway user (mode 0700). Excludes url, httpHost, httpPort, and receiveMode on-start. HTTP remains the default; socket failures never fall back to HTTP.

channels.signal.transport.url.label: Signal Transport URL
channels.signal.transport.url.help: Base URL for an external-native or container transport, or the connection endpoint for a managed-native daemon when it differs from the bind address.

channels.slack.historyLimit.help: Automatic observed-message context uses a default of 50 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables automatic injection. The JSON integer maximum selects the 50-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.slack.accounts.*.historyLimit.help: Automatic observed-message context uses a default of 50 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables automatic injection. The JSON integer maximum selects the 50-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.slack.dmHistoryLimit.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 0 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 0-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.slack.accounts.*.dmHistoryLimit.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 0 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 0-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.slack.dms.*.historyLimit.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 0 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 0-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.slack.accounts.*.dms.*.historyL.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 0 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 0-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.slack.requireMentionInBotThread.label: Require Mention in Bot Threads
channels.slack.requireMentionInBotThread.help: Override mention gating in threads whose root message was sent by this bot. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention even when implicit reply or participation signals are enabled. Omit to preserve the existing mention policy. Channel settings override account settings; access restrictions still apply.

channels.slack.accounts.*.requireMention.label: Require Mention in Bot Threads
channels.slack.accounts.*.requireMention.help: Override mention gating in threads whose root message was sent by this bot. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention even when implicit reply or participation signals are enabled. Omit to preserve the existing mention policy. Channel settings override account settings; access restrictions still apply.

channels.slack.channels.*.requireMention.label: Require Mention in Bot Threads
channels.slack.channels.*.requireMention.help: Override mention gating in threads whose root message was sent by this bot. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention even when implicit reply or participation signals are enabled. Omit to preserve the existing mention policy. Channel settings override account settings; access restrictions still apply.

channels.slack.accounts.*.channels.*.req.label: Require Mention in Bot Threads
channels.slack.accounts.*.channels.*.req.help: Override mention gating in threads whose root message was sent by this bot. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention even when implicit reply or participation signals are enabled. Omit to preserve the existing mention policy. Channel settings override account settings; access restrictions still apply.

channels.slack.postAs.label: Slack Identity
channels.slack.postAs.help: Select "bot" (default) for the classic Slack app/bot identity or "user" to post as the authorizing human through a user token while the app carries event transport.

channels.slack.dmPolicy.label: Slack DM Policy
channels.slack.dmPolicy.help: Direct message access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.slack.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.slack.configWrites.label: Slack Config Writes
channels.slack.configWrites.help: Allow Slack to write config in response to channel events/commands (default: true).

channels.slack.mentionPatterns.label: Slack Mention Pattern Policy
channels.slack.mentionPatterns.help: Scopes configured groupChat mentionPatterns to selected Slack channel IDs. Native Slack @mentions still trigger even when regex patterns are denied.

channels.slack.mentionPatterns.mode.label: Slack Mention Pattern Mode
channels.slack.mentionPatterns.mode.help: "allow" enables configured regex mention patterns unless denyIn matches; "deny" disables them unless allowIn matches.

channels.slack.mentionPatterns.allowIn.label: Slack Mention Pattern Allowlist
channels.slack.mentionPatterns.allowIn.help: Slack channel IDs where configured regex mention patterns are enabled when mode is deny.

channels.slack.mentionPatterns.denyIn.label: Slack Mention Pattern Denylist
channels.slack.mentionPatterns.denyIn.help: Slack channel IDs where configured regex mention patterns are disabled. Native @mentions still trigger.

channels.slack.commands.native.label: Slack Native Commands
channels.slack.commands.native.help: Override native commands for Slack (bool or "auto").

channels.slack.commands.nativeSkills.label: Slack Native Skill Commands
channels.slack.commands.nativeSkills.help: Override native skill commands for Slack (bool or "auto").

channels.slack.implicitMentions.label: Slack Implicit Mentions
channels.slack.implicitMentions.help: Control which Slack reply, quote, and thread-participation signals count as mentions. Unset flags preserve the channel defaults.

channels.slack.implicitMentions.replyToB.label: Slack Replies to Bot
channels.slack.implicitMentions.replyToB.help: Treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.slack.implicitMentions.quotedBo.label: Slack Quoted Bot Messages
channels.slack.implicitMentions.quotedBo.help: Treat messages quoting the bot as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.slack.implicitMentions.threadPa.label: Slack Thread Participation
channels.slack.implicitMentions.threadPa.help: Treat follow-ups in threads where the bot participated as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.slack.streaming.label: Slack Streaming Mode
channels.slack.streaming.help: Unified Slack stream preview mode: "off" | "partial" | "block" | "progress" (default). Legacy boolean/streamMode keys are auto-mapped.

channels.slack.streaming.mode.label: Slack Streaming Mode
channels.slack.streaming.mode.help: Slack preview mode: "off" | "partial" | "block" | "progress" (default). Default progress outside reply threads uses only a temporary typing reaction. Any explicit streaming.progress setting opts top-level turns into a preview, except nativeTaskCards: true, which only affects threads.

channels.slack.streaming.chunkMode.label: Slack Chunk Mode
channels.slack.streaming.chunkMode.help: Chunking mode for outbound Slack text delivery: "length" (default) or "newline".

channels.slack.streaming.block.enabled.label: Slack Block Streaming Enabled
channels.slack.streaming.block.enabled.help: Enable chunked block-style Slack preview delivery when channels.slack.streaming.mode="block".

channels.slack.streaming.block.coalesce.label: Slack Block Streaming Coalesce
channels.slack.streaming.block.coalesce.help: Merge streamed Slack block replies before final delivery.

channels.slack.streaming.nativeTransport.label: Slack Native Streaming
channels.slack.streaming.nativeTransport.help: Enable native Slack text streaming (chat.startStream/chat.appendStream/chat.stopStream) when channels.slack.streaming.mode is partial (default: true). Native streaming and Slack session status require a reply thread target; top-level DMs can still use draft post-and-edit preview streaming.

channels.slack.streaming.preview.toolPro.label: Slack Draft Tool Progress
channels.slack.streaming.preview.toolPro.help: Show tool/progress activity in the live draft preview message (default: true). Set false to hide interim tool updates while the draft preview stays active.

channels.slack.streaming.preview.command.label: Slack Draft Command Text
channels.slack.streaming.preview.command.help: Command/exec detail in preview tool-progress lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.slack.streaming.progress.style.label: Slack Progress Style
channels.slack.streaming.progress.style.help: Slack progress presentation: "card" uses structured task/session cards; "compact" keeps a temporary editable text draft. The final response is posted as a new message, then the draft is deleted after confirmed delivery. Outside reply threads, unset progress presentation is quiet. Any explicit streaming.progress setting in the merged root and account config opts top-level turns into a preview, except nativeTaskCards: true, which only affects threads. This includes commentary or label alone. The style defaults to "compact" when toolProgress is explicitly false, otherwise "card".

channels.slack.streaming.progress.native.label: Slack Native Progress Task Cards
channels.slack.streaming.progress.native.help: Slack native task-card progress updates when channels.slack.streaming.mode="progress", progress.style="card", and streaming.nativeTransport is enabled. Set false to fall back to the Block Kit progress card. Default: true.

channels.slack.streaming.progress.label.label: Slack Progress Label
channels.slack.streaming.progress.label.help: Initial progress draft title. Use "auto" for built-in single-word labels, a custom string, or false to hide the title.

channels.slack.streaming.progress.labels.label: Slack Progress Label Pool
channels.slack.streaming.progress.labels.help: Candidate labels for streaming.progress.label="auto". Leave unset to use OpenClaw built-in progress labels.

channels.slack.streaming.progress.maxLin.label: Slack Progress Max Lines
channels.slack.streaming.progress.maxLin.help: Maximum number of compact progress lines to keep below the draft label (default: 8).

channels.slack.streaming.progress.maxLin.label: Slack Progress Max Line Chars
channels.slack.streaming.progress.maxLin.help: Maximum characters per compact progress line before truncation (default: 120). Prose cuts at word boundaries; commands and paths keep useful suffixes.

channels.slack.streaming.progress.toolPr.label: Slack Progress Tool Lines
channels.slack.streaming.progress.toolPr.help: Show individual tool activity, including intermediate failures, in progress drafts (default: false). Native cards add a task row per tool call. Block Kit cards add tool activity, the plan checklist, and tool/file/time totals while working; finished cards retain only file diff totals. Default Block Kit cards show commentary and text, approval requests, and available session links. Failed turns show a plain Failed line on the Block Kit card, even without an error reply.

channels.slack.streaming.progress.comman.label: Slack Progress Command Text
channels.slack.streaming.progress.comman.help: Command/exec detail in progress draft lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.slack.joinIntro.label: Slack Channel Join Introduction
channels.slack.joinIntro.help: Post one brief, room-specific introduction when the bot joins an allowed Slack channel (default: true). Account settings override the channel-wide setting.

channels.slack.allowBots.label: Slack Allow Bot Messages
channels.slack.allowBots.help: Allow bot-authored messages to trigger Slack replies (default: true). Set false to disable bot-triggered turns, or "mentions" to require a mention. Channel access, mention, owner-presence, and loop-protection rules still apply; accessible bot-authored context remains available independently.

channels.slack.botLoopProtection.label: Slack Bot Loop Protection
channels.slack.botLoopProtection.help: Sliding-window guard for Slack bot-to-bot loops. Default is enabled whenever allowBots lets bot-authored messages reach dispatch.

channels.slack.botLoopProtection.enabled.label: Slack Bot Loop Protection Enabled
channels.slack.botLoopProtection.enabled.help: Enable the bot-pair loop guard. Defaults to true when allowBots is true or "mentions", and false when bot messages are ignored.

channels.slack.botLoopProtection.maxEven.label: Slack Bot Loop Events per Window
channels.slack.botLoopProtection.maxEven.help: Maximum accepted bot-pair messages within the sliding window before suppression starts. Default: 20.

channels.slack.botLoopProtection.windowS.label: Slack Bot Loop Window Seconds
channels.slack.botLoopProtection.windowS.help: Sliding window length for counting bot-pair messages. Default: 60.

channels.slack.botLoopProtection.cooldow.label: Slack Bot Loop Cooldown Seconds
channels.slack.botLoopProtection.cooldow.help: How long to suppress the bot pair after it exceeds the budget. Default: 60.

channels.slack.relay.label: Slack Relay Mode
channels.slack.relay.help: Relay-delivered Slack events. Use with mode="relay" when openclaw-slack-router owns the Slack Socket Mode connection.

channels.slack.relay.url.label: Slack Relay URL
channels.slack.relay.url.help: Full websocket URL for openclaw-slack-router. Include the route path, for example ws://127.0.0.1:8081/gateway/ws.

channels.slack.relay.authToken.label: Slack Relay Auth Token
channels.slack.relay.authToken.help: Bearer token used by this gateway to authenticate its reverse websocket connection to openclaw-slack-router.

channels.slack.relay.gatewayId.label: Slack Relay Gateway ID
channels.slack.relay.gatewayId.help: Destination id that openclaw-slack-router uses when routing user-group mentions to this gateway.

channels.slack.botToken.label: Slack Bot Token
channels.slack.botToken.help: Slack bot token used for standard chat actions in the configured workspace. Keep this credential scoped and rotate if workspace app permissions change.

channels.slack.appToken.label: Slack App Token
channels.slack.appToken.help: Slack app-level token used for Socket Mode connections and event transport when enabled. Use least-privilege app scopes and store this token as a secret.

channels.slack.userToken.label: Slack User Token
channels.slack.userToken.help: Optional Slack user token for workflows requiring user-context API access beyond bot permissions. Use sparingly and audit scopes because this token can carry broader authority.

channels.slack.userTokenReadOnly.label: Slack User Token Read Only
channels.slack.userTokenReadOnly.help: When true, treat configured Slack user token usage as read-only helper behavior where possible. Keep enabled if you only need supplemental reads without user-context writes.

channels.slack.execApprovals.label: Slack Exec Approvals
channels.slack.execApprovals.help: Slack-native exec approval routing and approver authorization. Set enabled to "auto" or true to enable DM-first native approvals when approvers can be resolved for this Slack account; unset or false disables them.

channels.slack.presenceEvents.label: Slack Presence Events
channels.slack.presenceEvents.help: Poll observed human participants and wake the routed agent on away-to-active transitions. Default: "off".

channels.slack.presenceEvents.mode.label: Slack Presence Event Mode
channels.slack.presenceEvents.mode.help: "off" disables polling; "auto" covers DMs, MPIMs, and recent threads with up to 8 observed people; "on" also covers larger threads and top-level channels.

channels.slack.presenceEvents.prompt.label: Slack Presence Event Prompt
channels.slack.presenceEvents.prompt.help: Replace the default greeting guidance appended after presence facts. Use an empty string to omit event-specific guidance and let workspace instructions such as AGENTS.md govern behavior. Maximum: 20,000 characters.

channels.slack.channels.*.presenceEvents.label: Slack Channel Presence Event Mode
channels.slack.channels.*.presenceEvents.help: Override presence events for one Slack channel. Use "on" to include large threads or top-level channel sessions.

channels.slack.channels.*.presenceEvents.label: Slack Channel Presence Event Prompt
channels.slack.channels.*.presenceEvents.help: Override the account-level presence-event prompt for one Slack channel. Maximum: 20,000 characters.

channels.slack.execApprovals.enabled.label: Slack Exec Approvals Enabled
channels.slack.execApprovals.enabled.help: Controls Slack native exec approvals for this account: "auto" or true enables DM-first native approvals when approvers can be resolved; unset or false disables them.

channels.slack.execApprovals.approvers.label: Slack Exec Approval Approvers
channels.slack.execApprovals.approvers.help: Slack user IDs allowed to approve exec requests for this workspace account. Use Slack user IDs or user targets such as `U123`, `user:U123`, or `<@U123>`. If you leave this unset, OpenClaw falls back to commands.ownerAllowFrom when possible.

channels.slack.execApprovals.agentFilter.label: Slack Exec Approval Agent Filter
channels.slack.execApprovals.agentFilter.help: Optional allowlist of agent IDs eligible for Slack exec approvals, for example `["main", "ops-agent"]`. Use this to keep approval prompts scoped to the agents you actually operate from Slack.

channels.slack.execApprovals.sessionFilt.label: Slack Exec Approval Session Filter
channels.slack.execApprovals.sessionFilt.help: Optional session-key filters matched as substring or regex-style patterns before Slack approval routing is used. Use narrow patterns so Slack approvals only appear for intended sessions.

channels.slack.execApprovals.target.label: Slack Exec Approval Target
channels.slack.execApprovals.target.help: Controls where Slack approval prompts are sent: "dm" sends to approver DMs (default), "channel" sends to the originating Slack chat/thread, and "both" sends to both. Channel delivery exposes the command text to the chat, so only use it in trusted channels.

channels.slack.thread.historyScope.label: Slack Thread History Scope
channels.slack.thread.historyScope.help: Scope for Slack thread history context ("thread" isolates per thread; "channel" reuses channel history).

channels.slack.thread.inheritParent.label: Slack Thread Parent Inheritance
channels.slack.thread.inheritParent.help: If true, Slack thread sessions inherit the parent channel chat history (default: false).

channels.slack.thread.initialHistoryLimi.label: Slack Thread Initial History Limit
channels.slack.thread.initialHistoryLimi.help: Maximum number of existing Slack thread messages to fetch when starting a new thread session (default: 20, set to 0 to disable).

channels.sms.label: SMS
channels.sms.help: Twilio-backed SMS/MMS with inbound webhooks and outbound replies.

channels.sms.accountSid.label: Twilio Account SID
channels.sms.accountSid.help: Twilio Account SID used for SMS outbound API calls.

channels.sms.authToken.label: Twilio Auth Token
channels.sms.authToken.help: Twilio Auth Token used to sign webhook validation and SMS outbound API calls.

channels.sms.fromNumber.label: SMS From Number
channels.sms.fromNumber.help: Twilio SMS-capable phone number in E.164 format; outbound attachments also require MMS capability.

channels.sms.messagingServiceSid.label: Twilio Messaging Service SID
channels.sms.messagingServiceSid.help: Twilio Messaging Service SID to use instead of a dedicated fromNumber.

channels.sms.defaultTo.label: SMS Default To Number
channels.sms.defaultTo.help: Optional default outbound phone number used when a send flow omits an explicit SMS target.

channels.sms.publicWebhookUrl.label: SMS Public Webhook URL
channels.sms.publicWebhookUrl.help: Public URL configured in Twilio for incoming messages. Must match Twilio's signed URL exactly; outbound MMS also requires this same path to be reachable over HTTPS.

channels.sms.webhookPath.label: SMS Webhook Path
channels.sms.webhookPath.help: Gateway HTTP path that receives Twilio incoming-message webhooks. Use a distinct path per account.

channels.sms.dmPolicy.label: SMS DM Policy
channels.sms.dmPolicy.help: Direct SMS access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.sms.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.sms.allowFrom.label: SMS Allow From
channels.sms.allowFrom.help: Allowed sender phone numbers in E.164 format, or * when dmPolicy is open.

channels.sms.accounts.*.defaultTo.help: Target used for outbound messages when the caller supplies none.

channels.sms.textChunkLimit.label: SMS Text Chunk Limit
channels.sms.textChunkLimit.help: Maximum characters per outbound SMS chunk before OpenClaw splits long replies.

channels.synology-chat.label: Synology Chat
channels.synology-chat.help: Connect your Synology NAS Chat to OpenClaw with full agent capabilities.

channels.synology-chat.webhookUrl.help: Public URL the provider should deliver webhooks to.

channels.synology-chat.accounts.*.webhoo.help: Public URL the provider should deliver webhooks to.

channels.telegram.label: Telegram
channels.telegram.help: simplest way to get started — register a bot with @BotFather and get going.

channels.telegram.historyLimit.help: Automatic observed-message context uses a default of 50 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables automatic injection. The JSON integer maximum selects the 50-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.telegram.accounts.*.historyLimi.help: Automatic observed-message context uses a default of 50 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables automatic injection. The JSON integer maximum selects the 50-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.telegram.dmHistoryLimit.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 10 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 10-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.telegram.accounts.*.dmHistoryLi.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 10 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 10-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.telegram.dms.*.historyLimit.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 10 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 10-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.telegram.accounts.*.dms.*.histo.help: Automatic observed-DM context uses a default of 10 and a maximum of 200 messages; 0 disables that extra context. The JSON integer maximum selects the 10-message default. Chat history trimming separately counts user turns, where 0 means no trimming. The observed-message cap does not rewrite saved values.

channels.telegram.groups.*.requireMentio.label: Telegram Bot Topic Mention Requirement
channels.telegram.groups.*.requireMentio.help: Override mention gating in forum topics created by this bot. False allows unmentioned messages; true requires a mention even for replies to the bot. Topic settings override group settings. Omit to preserve existing behavior. Unknown or evicted topic ownership keeps the normal policy. Telegram privacy mode must allow ordinary group messages; sender and visible-reply policies still apply.

channels.telegram.groups.*.topics.*.requ.label: Telegram Bot Topic Mention Requirement
channels.telegram.groups.*.topics.*.requ.help: Override mention gating in forum topics created by this bot. False allows unmentioned messages; true requires a mention even for replies to the bot. Topic settings override group settings. Omit to preserve existing behavior. Unknown or evicted topic ownership keeps the normal policy. Telegram privacy mode must allow ordinary group messages; sender and visible-reply policies still apply.

channels.telegram.accounts.*.groups.*.re.label: Telegram Bot Topic Mention Requirement
channels.telegram.accounts.*.groups.*.re.help: Override mention gating in forum topics created by this bot. False allows unmentioned messages; true requires a mention even for replies to the bot. Topic settings override group settings. Omit to preserve existing behavior. Unknown or evicted topic ownership keeps the normal policy. Telegram privacy mode must allow ordinary group messages; sender and visible-reply policies still apply.

channels.telegram.accounts.*.groups.*.to.label: Telegram Bot Topic Mention Requirement
channels.telegram.accounts.*.groups.*.to.help: Override mention gating in forum topics created by this bot. False allows unmentioned messages; true requires a mention even for replies to the bot. Topic settings override group settings. Omit to preserve existing behavior. Unknown or evicted topic ownership keeps the normal policy. Telegram privacy mode must allow ordinary group messages; sender and visible-reply policies still apply.

channels.telegram.customCommands.label: Telegram Custom Commands
channels.telegram.customCommands.help: Additional Telegram bot menu commands (merged with native; conflicts ignored).

channels.telegram.botToken.label: Telegram Bot Token
channels.telegram.botToken.help: Telegram bot token used to authenticate Bot API requests for this account/provider config. Use secret/env substitution and rotate tokens if exposure is suspected.

channels.telegram.joinIntro.label: Telegram Group Join Introduction
channels.telegram.joinIntro.help: Send one room-aware introduction when the bot joins an allowed group or supergroup (default: true). Telegram cannot provide message history from before the bot joined.

channels.telegram.dmPolicy.label: Telegram DM Policy
channels.telegram.dmPolicy.help: Direct message access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.telegram.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.telegram.configWrites.label: Telegram Config Writes
channels.telegram.configWrites.help: Allow Telegram to write config in response to channel events/commands (default: true).

channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.label: Telegram Mention Pattern Policy
channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.help: Scopes configured groupChat mentionPatterns to selected Telegram group chat IDs or chatId:topic:threadId topic IDs. Native Telegram bot mentions still trigger even when regex patterns are denied.

channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.mode.label: Telegram Mention Pattern Mode
channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.mode.help: "allow" enables configured regex mention patterns unless denyIn matches; "deny" disables them unless allowIn matches.

channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.allowI.label: Telegram Mention Pattern Allowlist
channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.allowI.help: Telegram group chat IDs or chatId:topic:threadId topic IDs where configured regex mention patterns are enabled when mode is deny.

channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.denyIn.label: Telegram Mention Pattern Denylist
channels.telegram.mentionPatterns.denyIn.help: Telegram group chat IDs or chatId:topic:threadId topic IDs where configured regex mention patterns are disabled. Native bot mentions still trigger.

channels.telegram.commands.native.label: Telegram Native Commands
channels.telegram.commands.native.help: Override native commands for Telegram (bool or "auto").

channels.telegram.commands.nativeSkills.label: Telegram Native Skill Commands
channels.telegram.commands.nativeSkills.help: Override native skill commands for Telegram (bool or "auto").

channels.telegram.streaming.label: Telegram Streaming Mode
channels.telegram.streaming.help: Unified Telegram stream preview mode: "off" | "partial" | "block" | "progress" (default: "progress"). "progress" keeps a single editable progress draft until final delivery. Legacy boolean/streamMode keys are detected; run doctor --fix to migrate.

channels.telegram.streaming.chunkMode.label: Telegram Chunk Mode
channels.telegram.streaming.chunkMode.help: Chunking mode for outbound Telegram text delivery: "length" (default) or "newline".

channels.telegram.streaming.block.enable.label: Telegram Block Streaming Enabled
channels.telegram.streaming.block.enable.help: Enable normal Telegram block replies. This takes precedence over editable preview delivery.

channels.telegram.streaming.block.coales.label: Telegram Block Streaming Coalesce
channels.telegram.streaming.block.coales.help: Merge streamed Telegram block replies before sending final delivery.

channels.telegram.streaming.preview.chun.label: Telegram Draft Chunk Min Chars
channels.telegram.streaming.preview.chun.help: Minimum chars before emitting a Telegram block preview chunk when channels.telegram.streaming.mode="block".

channels.telegram.streaming.preview.chun.label: Telegram Draft Chunk Max Chars
channels.telegram.streaming.preview.chun.help: Target max size for a Telegram block preview chunk when channels.telegram.streaming.mode="block".

channels.telegram.streaming.preview.chun.label: Telegram Draft Chunk Break Preference
channels.telegram.streaming.preview.chun.help: Preferred breakpoints for Telegram draft chunks (paragraph | newline | sentence).

channels.telegram.streaming.preview.tool.label: Telegram Draft Tool Progress
channels.telegram.streaming.preview.tool.help: Show tool/progress activity in the live draft preview message (default: true when preview streaming is active). Set false to keep tool updates out of the edited Telegram preview.

channels.telegram.streaming.preview.comm.label: Telegram Draft Command Text
channels.telegram.streaming.preview.comm.help: Command/exec detail in preview tool-progress lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.telegram.streaming.progress.lab.label: Telegram Progress Label
channels.telegram.streaming.progress.lab.help: Initial progress draft title. Use "auto" for built-in single-word labels, a custom string, or false to hide the title.

channels.telegram.streaming.progress.lab.label: Telegram Progress Label Pool
channels.telegram.streaming.progress.lab.help: Candidate labels for streaming.progress.label="auto". Leave unset to use the built-in "Working" label.

channels.telegram.streaming.progress.max.label: Telegram Progress Max Lines
channels.telegram.streaming.progress.max.help: Maximum number of compact progress lines to keep below the draft label (default: 8).

channels.telegram.streaming.progress.max.label: Telegram Progress Max Line Chars
channels.telegram.streaming.progress.max.help: Maximum characters per compact progress line before truncation (default: 120). Prose cuts at word boundaries; commands and paths keep useful suffixes.

channels.telegram.streaming.progress.too.label: Telegram Progress Tool Lines
channels.telegram.streaming.progress.too.help: Show individual tool activity, including intermediate failures, in progress drafts (default: false). Quiet drafts retain plans, approval requests, and authored progress text. Terminal task errors remain visible.

channels.telegram.streaming.progress.com.label: Telegram Progress Command Text
channels.telegram.streaming.progress.com.help: Command/exec detail in progress draft lines: "status" is the safe default; "raw" opts into command text.

channels.telegram.streaming.progress.com.label: Telegram Progress Commentary
channels.telegram.streaming.progress.com.help: Show assistant commentary/preamble text in the temporary progress draft. Final answer delivery is unchanged.

channels.telegram.richMessages.label: Telegram Rich Messages
channels.telegram.richMessages.help: Opt into Bot API 10.3 rich text sends and edits, including native tables and rich media. Default: false because some current Telegram clients render these messages as unsupported.

channels.telegram.widgets.label: Telegram Message Widgets
channels.telegram.widgets.help: Opt into Bot API 10.4 message widgets: show_widget sends interactive widgets in private chats, and taps update them in place. Default: false because older Telegram clients cannot render widgets.

channels.telegram.network.autoSelectFami.label: Telegram autoSelectFamily
channels.telegram.network.autoSelectFami.help: Override Node autoSelectFamily for Telegram (true=enable, false=disable).

channels.telegram.network.dangerouslyAll.label: Telegram Dangerously Allow Private Network
channels.telegram.network.dangerouslyAll.help: Dangerous opt-in for trusted fake-IP or transparent-proxy environments where Telegram media downloads resolve api.telegram.org to private/internal/special-use addresses.

channels.telegram.silentErrorReplies.label: Telegram Silent Error Replies
channels.telegram.silentErrorReplies.help: When true, Telegram bot replies marked as errors are sent silently (no notification sound). Default: false.

channels.telegram.apiRoot.label: Telegram API Root URL
channels.telegram.apiRoot.help: Custom Telegram Bot API root URL. Use the API root only (for example https://api.telegram.org), not a full /bot<TOKEN> endpoint. Use for self-hosted Bot API servers (https://github.com/tdlib/telegram-bot-api) or reverse proxies in regions where api.telegram.org is blocked.

channels.telegram.trustedLocalFileRoots.label: Telegram Trusted Local File Roots
channels.telegram.trustedLocalFileRoots.help: Trusted local filesystem roots for self-hosted Telegram Bot API file_path values. Exact in-root paths are read directly; container paths under /var/lib/telegram-bot-api can map into a host volume mount. Other absolute paths are rejected.

channels.telegram.autoTopicLabel.label: Telegram Auto Topic Label
channels.telegram.autoTopicLabel.help: Auto-rename DM forum topics on first message using LLM. Default: true. Set to false to disable, or use object form { enabled: true, prompt: '...' } for custom prompt.

channels.telegram.autoTopicLabel.enabled.label: Telegram Auto Topic Label Enabled
channels.telegram.autoTopicLabel.enabled.help: Whether auto topic labeling is enabled. Default: true.

channels.telegram.autoTopicLabel.prompt.label: Telegram Auto Topic Label Prompt
channels.telegram.autoTopicLabel.prompt.help: Custom prompt for LLM-based topic naming. The user message is appended after the prompt.

channels.telegram.capabilities.inlineBut.label: Telegram Inline Buttons
channels.telegram.capabilities.inlineBut.help: Enable Telegram inline button components for supported command and interaction surfaces. Disable if your deployment needs plain-text-only compatibility behavior.

channels.telegram.execApprovals.label: Telegram Exec Approvals
channels.telegram.execApprovals.help: Telegram-native exec approval routing and approver authorization. When unset, OpenClaw auto-enables DM-first native approvals if approvers can be resolved for the selected bot account.

channels.telegram.execApprovals.enabled.label: Telegram Exec Approvals Enabled
channels.telegram.execApprovals.enabled.help: Controls Telegram native exec approvals for this account: unset or "auto" enables DM-first native approvals when approvers can be resolved, true forces native approvals on, and false disables them.

channels.telegram.execApprovals.approver.label: Telegram Exec Approval Approvers
channels.telegram.execApprovals.approver.help: Telegram user IDs allowed to approve exec requests for this bot account. Use numeric Telegram user IDs. If you leave this unset, OpenClaw falls back to numeric owner IDs inferred from commands.ownerAllowFrom when possible.

channels.telegram.execApprovals.agentFil.label: Telegram Exec Approval Agent Filter
channels.telegram.execApprovals.agentFil.help: Optional allowlist of agent IDs eligible for Telegram exec approvals, for example `["main", "ops-agent"]`. Use this to keep approval prompts scoped to the agents you actually operate from Telegram.

channels.telegram.execApprovals.sessionF.label: Telegram Exec Approval Session Filter
channels.telegram.execApprovals.sessionF.help: Optional session-key filters matched as substring or regex-style patterns before Telegram approval routing is used. Use narrow patterns so Telegram approvals only appear for intended sessions.

channels.telegram.execApprovals.target.label: Telegram Exec Approval Target
channels.telegram.execApprovals.target.help: Controls where Telegram approval prompts are sent: "dm" sends to approver DMs (default), "channel" sends to the originating Telegram chat/topic, and "both" sends to both. Channel delivery exposes the command text to the chat, so only use it in trusted groups/topics.

channels.telegram.threadBindings.enabled.label: Telegram Thread Binding Enabled
channels.telegram.threadBindings.enabled.help: Enable Telegram conversation-bound session spawning, routing, and delivery. Manage bindings with /agents and /session unbind|idle|max-age. Overrides session.threadBindings.enabled when set.

channels.telegram.threadBindings.idleHou.label: Telegram Thread Binding Idle Timeout (hours)
channels.telegram.threadBindings.idleHou.help: Inactivity window in hours for Telegram bound sessions. Set 0 to disable idle expiry (default: 24). Overrides session.threadBindings.idleHours when set.

channels.telegram.threadBindings.maxAgeH.label: Telegram Thread Binding Max Age (hours)
channels.telegram.threadBindings.maxAgeH.help: Optional hard max age in hours for Telegram bound sessions. Set 0 to disable hard cap (default: 0). Overrides session.threadBindings.maxAgeHours when set.

channels.telegram.threadBindings.spawnSe.label: Telegram Thread-Bound Session Spawn
channels.telegram.threadBindings.spawnSe.help: Allow /acp spawn --thread to bind Telegram topics when supported. Agent sessions_spawn(thread=true) never binds a Telegram conversation; it needs a channel that opens a separate thread.

channels.telegram.threadBindings.default.label: Telegram Thread Spawn Context
channels.telegram.threadBindings.default.help: Default native subagent context for thread-bound spawns. "fork" starts from the requester chat history; "isolated" starts clean. Default: "fork". Telegram cannot host agent-spawned thread sessions, so this has no effect for Telegram requests.

channels.tlon.label: Tlon
channels.tlon.help: decentralized messaging on Urbit; install the plugin to enable.

channels.tlon.implicitMentions.label: Tlon Implicit Mentions
channels.tlon.implicitMentions.help: Control which Tlon reply, quote, and thread-participation signals count as mentions. Unset flags preserve the channel defaults.

channels.tlon.implicitMentions.replyToBo.label: Tlon Replies to Bot
channels.tlon.implicitMentions.replyToBo.help: Treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.tlon.implicitMentions.quotedBot.label: Tlon Quoted Bot Messages
channels.tlon.implicitMentions.quotedBot.help: Treat messages quoting the bot as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.tlon.implicitMentions.threadPar.label: Tlon Thread Participation
channels.tlon.implicitMentions.threadPar.help: Treat follow-ups in threads where the bot participated as implicit mentions when the channel reports that signal.

channels.tlon.requireMentionInBotThreads.label: Require Mention in Bot Threads
channels.tlon.requireMentionInBotThreads.help: Override mention gating when this account's ship authored the thread root. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention even after the bot participates. Omit to preserve existing behavior. Sender authorization still applies.

channels.tlon.accounts.*.requireMentionI.label: Require Mention in Bot Threads
channels.tlon.accounts.*.requireMentionI.help: Override mention gating when this account's ship authored the thread root. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention even after the bot participates. Omit to preserve existing behavior. Sender authorization still applies.

channels.tlon.authorization.channelRules.label: Require Mention in Bot Threads
channels.tlon.authorization.channelRules.help: Override mention gating when this account's ship authored the thread root. False allows unmentioned replies; true requires a mention even after the bot participates. Omit to preserve existing behavior. Sender authorization still applies.

channels.tlon.crossChannelCitations.label: Tlon Cross-Channel Citations
channels.tlon.crossChannelCitations.help: Expand citations of posts from other channels into agent context. False expands only citations of the channel a message was posted in; the owner's 1:1 DMs are exempt. Default: true.

channels.tlon.accounts.*.crossChannelCit.label: Tlon Cross-Channel Citations
channels.tlon.accounts.*.crossChannelCit.help: Expand citations of posts from other channels into agent context. False expands only citations of the channel a message was posted in; the owner's 1:1 DMs are exempt. Default: true.

channels.whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
channels.whatsapp.help: works with your own number; recommend a separate phone + eSIM.

channels.whatsapp.dmPolicy.label: WhatsApp DM Policy
channels.whatsapp.dmPolicy.help: Direct message access control ("pairing" recommended). "open" requires channels.whatsapp.allowFrom=["*"].

channels.whatsapp.allowFrom.help: Sender ids allowed to reach the agent. Required by "allowlist"; use ["*"] to allow everyone.

channels.whatsapp.defaultTo.help: Target used for outbound messages when the caller supplies none.

channels.whatsapp.groupAllowFrom.help: Sender ids allowed in group chats. Falls back to allowFrom when unset.

channels.whatsapp.accounts.*.defaultTo.help: Target used for outbound messages when the caller supplies none.

channels.whatsapp.selfChatMode.label: WhatsApp Self-Phone Mode
channels.whatsapp.selfChatMode.help: Same-phone setup (bot uses your personal WhatsApp number).

channels.whatsapp.direct.label: WhatsApp Direct Chat Overrides
channels.whatsapp.direct.help: Per-conversation overrides keyed by WhatsApp DM id. Applied after a DM is already admitted by dmPolicy; "*" supplies a default without admitting anyone.

channels.whatsapp.pluginHooks.label: WhatsApp Plugin Hooks
channels.whatsapp.pluginHooks.help: Opt in to broadcasting inbound WhatsApp events to plugins. Payloads carry personal content, so only enable it for plugins you trust.

channels.whatsapp.configWrites.label: WhatsApp Config Writes
channels.whatsapp.configWrites.help: Allow WhatsApp to write config in response to channel events/commands (default: true).

channels.whatsapp.actions.calls.label: WhatsApp Voice Calls
channels.whatsapp.actions.calls.help: Expose the experimental requester-bound WhatsApp voice-call tool. Default: false. Requires a separately paired MeowCaller CLI.

channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.label: WhatsApp Mention Pattern Policy
channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.help: Scopes configured groupChat mentionPatterns to selected WhatsApp conversation IDs such as 123@g.us.

channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.mode.label: WhatsApp Mention Pattern Mode
channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.mode.help: "allow" enables configured regex mention patterns unless denyIn matches; "deny" disables them unless allowIn matches.

channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.allowI.label: WhatsApp Mention Pattern Allowlist
channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.allowI.help: WhatsApp conversation IDs where configured regex mention patterns are enabled when mode is deny.

channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.denyIn.label: WhatsApp Mention Pattern Denylist
channels.whatsapp.mentionPatterns.denyIn.help: WhatsApp conversation IDs where configured regex mention patterns are disabled.

channels.x.label: X (Twitter)
channels.x.help: Allowlisted mentions with thread context and public replies.

channels.zalo.label: Zalo
channels.zalo.help: Vietnam-focused messaging platform with Bot API.

channels.zalouser.label: Zalo Personal
channels.zalouser.help: Zalo personal account via QR code login.

channels.telegram.webhookSecret.help: Shared secret used to verify inbound webhook requests.

channels.telegram.accounts.*.webhookSecr.help: Shared secret used to verify inbound webhook requests.
